timeline.summary: SBI Mutual Fund reduced its shareholding in Happiest Minds Technologies to 5.61% following an open market sale of 1,25,000 shares on May 7, 2026.
Happiest Minds issued a press release on May 18, 2026, reassuring investors about growth prospects for its AI services amid platform players entering the space.

On May 25, 2026, Happiest Minds' board approved the FY27 plan, reconfirming 12.5% growth guidance with a 15% aspirational goal, and announced its 12th strategic AI initiative, the Enterprise AI Platform.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹604.08 Cr (+10.9% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹61.15 Cr (+79.9% YoY).
Happiest Minds Technologies reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹604.08 Cr, up 10.9% YoY, with PAT rising 79.9% YoY to ₹61.17 Cr.
Happiest Minds Technologies Limited uploaded the audio recording of its earnings call for Q1 FY2026 on May 29, 2026, hosted by **Praveen Kumar Darshankar**.
Happiest Minds reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹604.08 Cr and reconfirmed FY27 constant currency growth guidance of 12.5%.
Happiest Minds received NCLT approval for the amalgamation of its wholly owned subsidiary PureSoftware Technologies with an appointed date of April 1, 2026.
